spots.name: San José Museum of Art
spots.blurb: Art museum on South Market Street at the edge of Plaza de César Chávez.
spots.blurbEs: Museo de arte en South Market Street, al borde de la Plaza de César Chávez.

spots.name: The Tech Interactive
spots.blurb: Hands-on science and technology center facing Plaza de César Chávez.
spots.blurbEs: Centro interactivo de ciencia y tecnología frente a la Plaza de César Chávez.

spots.name: Children's Discovery Museum of San Jose
spots.blurb: Hands-on children's museum on Woz Way, at the south end of downtown.
spots.blurbEs: Museo interactivo para niños en Woz Way, en el extremo sur del centro.

spots.name: Plaza de César Chávez
spots.blurb: Downtown's central park plaza, ringed by museums, the cathedral and hotels.
spots.blurbEs: La plaza central del centro, rodeada de museos, la catedral y hoteles.

spots.name: Cathedral Basilica of St. Joseph
spots.blurb: Historic cathedral on Market Street, a short walk from the plaza.
spots.blurbEs: Catedral histórica en Market Street, a pocos pasos de la plaza.
